paragraphs.text: X is a legendary human spy from Bablovia in the Un-iverse .

X was introduced as a character in Unstable as a mysterious member of the Agents of S.N.E.A.K. . It is said that X has caused most leadership changes within the organization as different sources constantly pay him to steal the "Golden Ruler," which is an item that makes one the official leader of the organization. He wears a black overcoat with a hat that covers his eyes like a mask. He wields many contraptions , including a grappling gun, an extending claw, metal eye stalks, and a camera on his hat.

Unglued 's Ow set the record for the shortest card name, and was beaten by Unhinged 's ____ , which had no name. While Unstable was unable to break Unhinged 's record, it did include the first card with a one-letter name: X . X's entry in the Unstable FAQAWASLFAQPAFTIDAWABIAJTBT states "X gon' give it to ya," a reference to the song of the same name by DMX . X's 2025 Unknown Event card references Racer X, the Masked Racer from the Speed Racer franchise.
